integrity: The symbolic root/multiplicity proof is given in RESULT.md. The standalone Python checker independently verifies line restriction identities and finite-field consistency; finite enumeration is not asserted to prove the statement over an algebraic closure.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns the complete reduced singular support of the nine-variable degree-four elementary symmetric hypersurface in characteristic three; it does not establish the nonreduced Jacobian scheme, its primary decomposition or component-intersection multiplicities. The proof works over algebraically closed fields. Possible implicit equivalent coverage in other literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: The 351 singular lines of a characteristic-three elementary-symmetric quartic
